ns2:section.sectionText: DATA ANALYSIS & MACHINE LEARNING APPLICATIONS In this course, you will learn the fundamentals of how to analyze and interpret scientific data and apply modern machine learning tools and techniques to problems such as classification and regression. . Some knowledge of python preferred but not required. Prerequisites: Credit or Concurrent Registration: MATH 285; Credit for PHYS 225 and PHYS 325
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior class standing.
